title: Procurement of Advanced Diagnostic Imaging Systems
description: Supply, installation, and commissioning of digital radiography and ultrasound diagnostic imaging equipment with 5-year comprehensive warranty.
organization: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)

requirements.title: AERB / CDSCO Regulatory Approval
requirements.description: Valid regulatory type approval certificate from AERB and registration with CDSCO for medical imaging devices.

requirements.title: Annual Healthcare Turnover
requirements.description: Average annual turnover of at least ₹8 Crore over past 3 financial years.

requirements.title: ISO 13485 Medical Devices Certification
requirements.description: OEM manufacturing facility must hold ISO 13485:2016 certification.
